name: A Light in Dark Places
label: Quest
description: A Light in Dark Places: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We are not the only ones who celebrate this holiday, friend. All creatures, all cultures, are touched by the flame. Even in the darkest places, the fires are being lit.

If you wish to see them for yourself, travel into the depths. Seek out the bonfires burning within Stratholme, Scholomance, among the ogres of Dire Maul, and the halls of Blackrock Spire itself; I will await your return.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you found your way through the dark?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your essence sings with the energy of the flames you found, friend. The fire you encountered is potent, and with the right knowledge, its power can be harnessed...
The Flamekeeper mutters an incantation in a strange, arcane tongue. Then pulls out a glowing bottle.
Ah! Here we are. May this light your path, no matter where you tread.
